```{r setup, echo = F, warning = F, message = F}

library(seafisheries)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(lubridate)

source(here::here("workflows", "config", "config_alb.R"))

sp   <- tolower(species)               # "alb"
sp_n <- paste0(sp, "_n")               # target catch in numbers
sp_w <- paste0(sp, "_w")               # target catch in weight
n_cols <- paste0(species_all, "_n")
w_cols <- paste0(species_all, "_w")

if (!dir.exists(sql_folder)) stop("SQL folder not found: ", sql_folder,
								  ". Run workflows/sql_queries.R or check request_tag.")
dir.create(save_folder, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

pmask_lookup  <- readRDS(system.file("extdata/masks/pmask_lookup.RDS", package = "seafisheries"))
p5mask_lookup <- readRDS(system.file("extdata/masks/p5mask_lookup.RDS", package = "seafisheries"))
```

```{r helpers}
# ==============================================================================
# Helpers. To move to the package once stable.
# ==============================================================================

loadRaw <- function(name) {
	f <- file.path(sql_folder, paste0(name, ".RDS"))
	if (!file.exists(f)) stop("Missing raw file: ", f)
	readRDS(f)
}

saveIt <- function(obj, file) {
	if (save_it) saveRDS(obj, file.path(save_folder, file))
	invisible(obj)
}

# ---- Diagnostics -------------------------------------------------------------
# Everything is collected in .diag and saved to LL_processing_diagnostics.RDS,
# read by seafisheries::processing_report():
#   steps     one row per cleaning step: dataset, step, rows in, rows out
#   messages  console output of each step (what the package functions print)
#   warnings  warnings raised by the steps and by the checks of this document
#   tables    stage comparisons, coordinate conversion summaries, catch quality,
#             length matching coverage, ...
# Dataset names are keys: tables named stage_<dataset>, catch_quality_<dataset>
# and coords_<dataset>... are shown with their dataset in the report.
.diag <- new.env()
.diag$steps <- list(); .diag$messages <- list(); .diag$warnings <- list(); .diag$tables <- list()

diagAdd <- function(slot, name, value) {
	x <- .diag[[slot]]; x[[name]] <- value; .diag[[slot]] <- x
	invisible(value)
}

# Records a warning in the diagnostics and raises it.
diagWarn <- function(where, ...) {
	msg <- paste0(...)
	.diag$warnings[[where]] <- c(.diag$warnings[[where]], msg)
	warning(msg, call. = FALSE)
}

# Runs fun(df, ...), records rows in/out, the printed output and the warnings.
# x: a data.frame, or a list with $data. Returns what fun returns.
# Re-running a step (same dataset and step) replaces its previous record.
runStep <- function(x, dataset, step, fun, ...) {
	df_in <- if (is.data.frame(x)) x else x$data
	key <- paste(dataset, step, sep = " | ")
	out <- NULL
	warns <- character(0)
	msg <- withCallingHandlers(
		utils::capture.output(out <- fun(df_in, ...)),
		warning = function(w) warns <<- c(warns, conditionMessage(w)))
	df_out <- if (is.data.frame(out)) out else out$data
	.diag$steps[[key]] <- data.frame(dataset = dataset, step = step,
									 n_in = nrow(df_in), n_out = nrow(df_out))
	.diag$warnings[[key]] <- if (length(warns)) warns else NULL
	.diag$messages[[key]] <- if (length(msg)) msg else NULL
	if (verbose && length(msg)) cat(paste0("[", key, "]"), msg, sep = "\n")
	out
}

stepsTable <- function(ds = NULL) {
	st <- do.call(rbind, unname(.diag$steps))
	if (!is.null(ds)) st <- st[st$dataset == ds, ]
	st$removed <- st$n_in - st$n_out
	st$pct_removed <- round(100 * st$removed / st$n_in, 2)
	st
}

showSteps <- function(ds) {
	st <- stepsTable(ds)
	knitr::kable(st[, -1], row.names = FALSE, caption = paste("Cleaning steps:", ds))
}

# ---- Catch columns from sql_queries.R ----------------------------------------
# Catch quality before tidyCatch(): per species, records where the species is
# recorded, where all/some numbers are missing, where all/some weights are missing.
catchQuality <- function(df, dataset, w_unit) {
	do.call(rbind, lapply(species_all, function(s) {
		nrec <- df[[paste0(s, "_nrec")]]
		w_na <- df[[paste0(s, "_", w_unit, "_na")]]
		n_na <- if (paste0(s, "_n_na") %in% names(df)) df[[paste0(s, "_n_na")]] else 0 * nrec
		data.frame(dataset = dataset, species = s, records = nrow(df),
				   recorded = sum(nrec > 0),
				   n_all_missing = sum(nrec > 0 & n_na == nrec),
				   n_partial = sum(n_na > 0 & n_na < nrec),
				   w_all_missing = sum(nrec > 0 & w_na == nrec),
				   w_partial = sum(w_na > 0 & w_na < nrec))
	}))
}

# <sp>_n / <sp>_<w_unit> -> <sp>_n / <sp>_w (unit unchanged), per species:
#   not recorded (<sp>_nrec = 0)               -> n = 0, w = 0
#   recorded, every row without number          -> n = 0 (YFT run behaviour:
#                                                  the record and its other
#                                                  species are kept)
#   recorded, some rows without number          -> n = sum of the others
#   recorded, some or all rows without weight   -> w = NA (a sum would
#                                                  underestimate), extrapolated
#                                                  later as n x mean weight
#     ... unless no number at all                -> w = sum of the known weights
#                                                  (nothing to extrapolate from)
tidyCatch <- function(df, w_unit) {
	for (s in species_all) {
		n <- paste0(s, "_n"); w_raw <- paste0(s, "_", w_unit)
		absent  <- df[[paste0(s, "_nrec")]] == 0
		no_n    <- !absent & is.na(df[[n]])
		w_short <- !absent & df[[paste0(s, "_", w_unit, "_na")]] > 0
		df[[n]][absent | no_n] <- 0
		df[[w_raw]][absent] <- 0
		df[[w_raw]][w_short & !no_n] <- NA
		names(df)[names(df) == w_raw] <- paste0(s, "_w")
	}
	df
}

# Length code conversion to UF: UF = a * len^b, coefficients per code from
# config (len_conversion). Same as standardize_length_code(), whose
# coefficients are fixed (YFT).
convertLenCode <- function(df, conv, len_col = "len", code_col = "len_code") {
	n_conv <- c()
	for (code in names(conv)) {
		i <- which(df[[code_col]] == code)
		df[[len_col]][i] <- customRound(conv[[code]][["a"]] * as.numeric(df[[len_col]][i])^conv[[code]][["b"]])
		df[[code_col]][i] <- "UF"
		n_conv[code] <- length(i)
	}
	if (sum(n_conv) > 0) {
		cat(sum(n_conv), " lengths converted to UF (",
			paste(names(n_conv), n_conv, sep = ": ", collapse = ", "), "): ",
			round(sum(n_conv) / nrow(df) * 100, 2), "% of data\n", sep = "")
	}
	df
}

# Exact duplicates ignoring the record id (an id is unique by construction,
# so remove_duplicates() on a table with its id never removes anything).
removeContentDuplicates <- function(df, id_col) {
	n0 <- nrow(df)
	out <- dplyr::distinct(df, dplyr::across(-dplyr::all_of(id_col)), .keep_all = TRUE)
	report_removal(n0 - nrow(out), n0, paste0("exact duplicates ignoring ", id_col))
	out
}

# ---- Input vs processed tables -----------------------------------------------
# "Input" value/% relative to the RAW record count. "Processed" % = processed
# records (or ids) with a valid value / raw records (or ids) * 100.
pctRetained <- function(raw_valid_count, raw_total) {
	sprintf("%.2f%%", 100 * raw_valid_count / raw_total)
}

safeCol <- function(df, col) if (!is.null(col) && col %in% names(df)) df[[col]] else NULL

fmtCoord <- function(lat, lon) {
	if (is.null(lat) || is.null(lon)) return(NA_character_)
	lat_num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(lat))
	lon_num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(lon))
	if (all(is.na(lat_num)) || all(is.na(lon_num))) {
		return(sprintf("%s-%s ; %s,%s", min(lon, na.rm = TRUE), max(lon, na.rm = TRUE),
					   max(lat, na.rm = TRUE), min(lat, na.rm = TRUE)))
	}
	sprintf("%.1f-%.1fE ; %.1fN,%.1fS", min(lon_num, na.rm = TRUE), max(lon_num, na.rm = TRUE),
			max(lat_num, na.rm = TRUE), min(lat_num, na.rm = TRUE))
}

ecStageCompare <- function(raw_df, proc_df,
						   catch_n_col = sp_n, catch_w_col = sp_w,
						   effort_col = "E", hbf_col = "hbf",
						   flag_col = "flag", vessel_col = "vesselname", id_label = "Vessels",
						   date_col_raw = "ymd", date_col_proc = "ymd",
						   lat_col_raw, lon_col_raw, lat_col_proc, lon_col_proc,
						   n_unit_raw = "count", w_unit_raw = "kg", effort_unit_raw = "count",
						   w_unit_proc = "mt", effort_unit_proc = "hundred hooks",
						   coord_unit_raw = "raw (pre-conversion)", coord_unit_proc = "1 deg x 1 deg") {
	n_raw <- nrow(raw_df)
	fields <- "Total"; input_vals <- as.character(n_raw); input_units <- "records"
	proc_vals <- pctRetained(nrow(proc_df), n_raw); proc_units <- "-"

	add_row <- function(field, raw_x, proc_x, in_unit, out_unit, count_type = TRUE) {
		fields <<- c(fields, field)
		if (count_type) {
			input_vals <<- c(input_vals, pctRetained(sum(!is.na(raw_x)), n_raw))
			proc_vals  <<- c(proc_vals,  pctRetained(sum(!is.na(proc_x)), n_raw))
		} else {
			input_vals <<- c(input_vals, as.character(dplyr::n_distinct(raw_x, na.rm = TRUE)))
			proc_vals  <<- c(proc_vals,  pctRetained(dplyr::n_distinct(proc_x, na.rm = TRUE),
													 dplyr::n_distinct(raw_x, na.rm = TRUE)))
		}
		input_units <<- c(input_units, in_unit); proc_units <<- c(proc_units, out_unit)
	}

	add_row(paste0("Catch ", species, " (n)"), safeCol(raw_df, catch_n_col), safeCol(proc_df, catch_n_col), n_unit_raw, n_unit_raw)
	add_row(paste0("Catch ", species, " (w)"), safeCol(raw_df, catch_w_col), safeCol(proc_df, catch_w_col), w_unit_raw, w_unit_proc)
	add_row("Effort", safeCol(raw_df, effort_col), safeCol(proc_df, effort_col), effort_unit_raw, effort_unit_proc)
	if (!is.null(hbf_col) && hbf_col %in% names(raw_df))
		add_row("Hooks Between Floats", safeCol(raw_df, hbf_col), safeCol(proc_df, hbf_col), "count", "count")
	add_row("Countries", safeCol(raw_df, flag_col), safeCol(proc_df, flag_col), "flag", "flag", count_type = FALSE)
	if (!is.null(vessel_col))
		add_row(id_label, safeCol(raw_df, vessel_col), safeCol(proc_df, vessel_col), "id", "id", count_type = FALSE)

	date_raw <- safeCol(raw_df, date_col_raw); date_proc <- safeCol(proc_df, date_col_proc)
	fields <- c(fields, "Date Range")
	input_vals <- c(input_vals, if (!is.null(date_raw)) paste(format(range(date_raw, na.rm = TRUE)), collapse = " - ") else NA_character_)
	proc_vals  <- c(proc_vals,  if (!is.null(date_proc)) paste(format(range(date_proc, na.rm = TRUE)), collapse = " - ") else NA_character_)
	input_units <- c(input_units, "yyyy-mm-dd"); proc_units <- c(proc_units, "yyyy-mm-dd")

	fields <- c(fields, "Coordinates")
	input_vals <- c(input_vals, fmtCoord(safeCol(raw_df, lat_col_raw), safeCol(raw_df, lon_col_raw)))
	proc_vals  <- c(proc_vals,  fmtCoord(safeCol(proc_df, lat_col_proc), safeCol(proc_df, lon_col_proc)))
	input_units <- c(input_units, coord_unit_raw); proc_units <- c(proc_units, coord_unit_proc)

	tibble::tibble(Field = fields,
				   `Input value/range` = input_vals, `Input unit/format` = input_units,
				   `Processed value/range` = proc_vals, `Processed unit/format` = proc_units)
}

# LF variant. sample_group_cols: the columns defining one sample, applied to
# both raw and processed frames.
lfStageCompare <- function(raw_df, proc_df, sample_group_cols,
						   flag_col = "flag", fleet_col = NULL, id_label = "Vessels",
						   date_col_raw, date_col_proc, date_fmt = "yyyy-mm-dd",
						   lat_col_raw, lon_col_raw, lat_col_proc, lon_col_proc,
						   coord_unit_raw = "raw (pre-conversion)", coord_unit_proc = "1 deg x 1 deg") {
	n_samples <- function(df) {
		cols <- intersect(sample_group_cols, names(df))
		if (length(cols) == 0) return(NA_integer_)
		nrow(dplyr::distinct(df, dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(cols))))
	}
	n_raw_samples <- n_samples(raw_df); n_proc_samples <- n_samples(proc_df)

	fields <- "Samples"; input_vals <- as.character(n_raw_samples)
	proc_vals <- if (!is.na(n_raw_samples) && n_raw_samples > 0) pctRetained(n_proc_samples, n_raw_samples) else NA_character_
	input_units <- "-"; proc_units <- "-"

	fields <- c(fields, "Countries")
	input_vals <- c(input_vals, as.character(dplyr::n_distinct(safeCol(raw_df, flag_col), na.rm = TRUE)))
	proc_vals  <- c(proc_vals,  pctRetained(dplyr::n_distinct(safeCol(proc_df, flag_col), na.rm = TRUE),
											dplyr::n_distinct(safeCol(raw_df, flag_col), na.rm = TRUE)))
	input_units <- c(input_units, "flag"); proc_units <- c(proc_units, "flag")

	if (!is.null(fleet_col)) {
		fields <- c(fields, id_label)
		raw_fleet <- safeCol(raw_df, fleet_col); proc_fleet <- safeCol(proc_df, fleet_col)
		input_vals <- c(input_vals, if (!is.null(raw_fleet)) as.character(dplyr::n_distinct(raw_fleet, na.rm = TRUE)) else NA_character_)
		proc_vals  <- c(proc_vals,  if (!is.null(proc_fleet) && !is.null(raw_fleet))
			pctRetained(dplyr::n_distinct(proc_fleet, na.rm = TRUE), dplyr::n_distinct(raw_fleet, na.rm = TRUE))
			else "NA (column dropped by this stage)")
		input_units <- c(input_units, "id"); proc_units <- c(proc_units, "id")
	}

	fmt_date <- function(x) if (is.null(x)) NA_character_ else if (date_fmt == "yyyy-mm-dd")
		paste(format(range(x, na.rm = TRUE)), collapse = " - ") else paste(range(x, na.rm = TRUE), collapse = " - ")
	fields <- c(fields, "Date Range")
	input_vals <- c(input_vals, fmt_date(safeCol(raw_df, date_col_raw)))
	proc_vals  <- c(proc_vals,  fmt_date(safeCol(proc_df, date_col_proc)))
	input_units <- c(input_units, date_fmt); proc_units <- c(proc_units, date_fmt)

	fields <- c(fields, "Coordinates")
	input_vals <- c(input_vals, fmtCoord(safeCol(raw_df, lat_col_raw), safeCol(raw_df, lon_col_raw)))
	proc_vals  <- c(proc_vals,  fmtCoord(safeCol(proc_df, lat_col_proc), safeCol(proc_df, lon_col_proc)))
	input_units <- c(input_units, coord_unit_raw); proc_units <- c(proc_units, coord_unit_proc)

	tibble::tibble(Field = fields,
				   `Input value/range` = input_vals, `Input unit/format` = input_units,
				   `Processed value/range` = proc_vals, `Processed unit/format` = proc_units)
}
```

# Geo referenced catch effort data - Operational

All catch columns (`yft`, `skj`, `bet`, `alb`, `oth`) are kept: the species
composition is used to define the fisheries. The target species (`r species`)
only changes the catch column checked in the input/processed tables and, later,
the catch sent to SEAPODYM.

## Captain logbooks

```{r cap_load}
cap_sql <- loadRaw("EC_LL_captain")

# The SQL keeps every activity type; fishing sets only, as in the YFT run
EC_raw <- runStep(cap_sql, "captain", "activity_id == 1",
				  function(d) dplyr::filter(d, activity_id == 1))
# A few log_set_id appear twice (left join on log.sets_ll not 1:1). The catch
# is aggregated per log_set_id in the SQL, so each copy carries the full catch:
# one row per log_set_id is kept.
EC_raw <- runStep(EC_raw, "captain", "one row per log_set_id",
				  function(d) dplyr::distinct(d, log_set_id, .keep_all = TRUE))
diagAdd("tables", "catch_quality_captain", catchQuality(EC_raw, "captain", "kg"))

# catch in numbers and kg, effort in hooks
EC_raw <- EC_raw |>
	tidyCatch(w_unit = "kg") |>
	transmute(log_set_id, flag = flag_id, vesselname,
			  ymd = as.Date(logdate),
			  latitude = latd, longitude = lond,
			  E = as.numeric(hooks_n), hbf = as.numeric(hk_bt_flt_n),
			  across(all_of(c(n_cols, w_cols)), as.numeric))
rm(cap_sql)

# Snapshot for the input/processed diagnostic table
EC_cap_raw <- EC_raw
```

### Data cleaning

```{r cap_clean}
res <- runStep(EC_raw, "captain", "convert coordinates",
			   function(d) convert_coordinates_df(d, report = TRUE))
diagAdd("tables", "coords_captain", res$summary)
EC_raw <- res$data |>
	mutate(latCent = roundTo.5(latitude), lonCent = roundTo.5(longitude))

EC_raw <- runStep(EC_raw, "captain", "remove_invalid", remove_invalid,
				  required_cols = c("ymd", "latitude", "longitude", "E", n_cols))
EC_raw <- runStep(EC_raw, "captain", "remove_zero_fisheries", remove_zero_fisheries,
				  catch_cols = n_cols, effort_col = "E")
# check plot to determine cutoff in data
# plot_hbf_histogram(EC_raw, hbf_col = "hbf", xlim = c(0, 200), binwidth = 1, log_y = TRUE,
#					 candidate_ceilings = c(50, 60, 70, 80, 90, 100), facet_col = "flag")
EC_raw <- runStep(EC_raw, "captain", "treat_hbf", treat_hbf,
				  hbf_col = "hbf", threshold = hbf_threshold_cap)
EC_raw <- runStep(EC_raw, "captain", "trim_vesselname", trim_vesselname,
				  vesselname_col = "vesselname")
EC_raw <- runStep(EC_raw, "captain", "duplicates", removeContentDuplicates,
				  id_col = "log_set_id")
EC_raw <- runStep(EC_raw, "captain", "apply_pacific_mask", apply_pacific_mask,
				  lat_col = "latCent", lon_col = "lonCent", pmask_lookup = pmask_lookup)
if (use_temperature_mask)
	EC_raw <- runStep(EC_raw, "captain", "apply_temperature_mask", apply_temperature_mask,
					  mask_file = temperature_mask_file, min_temp = min_temp,
					  lat_col = "latCent", lon_col = "lonCent", date_col = "ymd")

# w in metric tons, E in hundreds of hooks
EC_raw <- EC_raw |>
	mutate(across(all_of(w_cols), ~ .x / 1000), E = E / 100, type = "captain")

EC_list <- runStep(EC_raw, "captain", "remove_dummy_fisheries", remove_dummy_fisheries,
				   catch_cols = n_cols, effort_col = "E", return_dummy = TRUE)
EC_cap <- EC_list$data
saveIt(EC_cap, "LL_EC_cap.RDS")
saveIt(EC_list$dummy, "LL_cap_dummy.RDS")
```

```{r cap_diag}
diagAdd("tables", "stage_captain",
		ecStageCompare(EC_cap_raw, EC_cap, vessel_col = "vesselname",
					   lat_col_raw = "latitude", lon_col_raw = "longitude",
					   lat_col_proc = "latCent", lon_col_proc = "lonCent"))
knitr::kable(.diag$tables$stage_captain, caption = "Captain's logbook data: input vs processed")
showSteps("captain")
```

```{r obs_clean}
	mutate(across(all_of(w_cols), ~ .x / 1000), E = E / 100, type = "observer")

EC_list <- runStep(EC_raw, "observer", "remove_dummy_fisheries", remove_dummy_fisheries,
```

## Merging captains and observers

```{r cap_obs_merge}
dedup_key <- c("flag", "vesselname", "ymd", "latCent", "lonCent")

# captain records also present in observer data -> observer takes precedence
ll_dupe <- EC_cap |> semi_join(EC_obs, by = dedup_key)
cap_unique <- EC_cap |> anti_join(ll_dupe, by = dedup_key)
EC_opr <- dplyr::bind_rows(cap_unique, EC_obs)

# NA weight with a zero count: species recorded with neither a number nor a
# weight. Its catch is unknown and becomes 0 at the weight extrapolation.
diagAdd("tables", "catch_unknown_opr", data.frame(species = species_all,
	records = sapply(species_all, function(s)
		sum(is.na(EC_opr[[paste0(s, "_w")]]) & EC_opr[[paste0(s, "_n")]] == 0)),
	row.names = NULL))

# diagnostic only: days where multiple captain sets collapsed into one observer record
row_dupe <- EC_cap |>
	group_by(flag, vesselname, ymd) |>
	filter(n() > 1) |>
	ungroup() |>
	semi_join(EC_obs, by = dedup_key)

diagAdd("tables", "merge_cap_obs", data.frame(
	captain = nrow(EC_cap), observer = nrow(EC_obs),
	captain_removed_as_observer_duplicate = nrow(ll_dupe),
	pct_of_captain = round(100 * nrow(ll_dupe) / nrow(EC_cap), 2),
	from_days_with_several_captain_sets = nrow(row_dupe),
	operational = nrow(EC_opr)))
knitr::kable(.diag$tables$merge_cap_obs, caption = "Merging captain and observer records")

# NA weights left (partial weights from tidyCatch()), extrapolated after the
# monthly aggregation
diagAdd("tables", "na_weight_opr",
		data.frame(column = w_cols, n_na = sapply(w_cols, function(w) sum(is.na(EC_opr[[w]]))),
				   row.names = NULL))

saveIt(EC_opr, "LL_EC_opr.RDS")
```

```{r rai_load}
rai_sql <- loadRaw("EC_LL_rai")
diagAdd("tables", "catch_quality_raised", catchQuality(rai_sql, "raised", "mt"))

# catch in numbers and metric tons, effort in hundreds of hooks
# best.l_best_agg has upper case column names (L_BEST_ID, FLAG_CODE, YY, ...)

	rename_with(tolower) |>
	tidyCatch(w_unit = "mt") |>
	transmute(l_best_id, flag = flag_code, fleet = fleet_code, fleet_desc,
			  yr = as.integer(yy), mm = as.integer(mm),
			  ymd = make_date(yr, mm, 15),
			  latitude = lat_short, longitude = lon_short,
			  E = as.numeric(hhooks),
			  across(all_of(c(n_cols, w_cols)), as.numeric))
rm(rai_sql)

# Snapshot for the input/processed diagnostic table
EC_rai_raw <- EC_raw
```

## Data cleaning

```{r rai_clean}
# Same species as the YFT run (no "oth" in the old raised query)
rai_catch_cols <- paste0(c("yft", "bet", "alb", "skj"), "_n")

res <- runStep(EC_raw, "raised", "convert coordinates",
			   function(d) convert_coordinates_df(d, report = TRUE))
diagAdd("tables", "coords_raised", res$summary)
EC_raw <- res$data |>
	mutate(latCent = latitude + 2.5, lonCent = longitude + 2.5)

# Only the target weight is required. Numbers may be NA (records reported in
# weight only): kept, as in the YFT run where they were set to 0. They get no
# fishery from the species composition but still count in the delta.
# Non-target weights may be NA (partial weights).
EC_raw <- runStep(EC_raw, "raised", "remove_invalid", remove_invalid,
				  required_cols = c("ymd", "latitude", "longitude", "E", sp_w))
EC_raw <- runStep(EC_raw, "raised", "remove_zero_fisheries", remove_zero_fisheries,
				  catch_cols = rai_catch_cols, effort_col = "E")
EC_raw <- runStep(EC_raw, "raised", "duplicates", removeContentDuplicates,
				  id_col = "l_best_id")
EC_raw <- runStep(EC_raw, "raised", "apply_pacific_mask", apply_pacific_mask,
				  lat_col = "latCent", lon_col = "lonCent", pmask_lookup = p5mask_lookup)
EC_raw <- EC_raw |> mutate(type = "raised")

EC_list <- runStep(EC_raw, "raised", "remove_dummy_fisheries", remove_dummy_fisheries,
				   catch_cols = rai_catch_cols, effort_col = "E", return_dummy = TRUE)
EC_rai <- EC_list$data

# The old query grouped records sharing flag/fleet/month/cell/hhooks into one
# row. Now one row per l_best_id: how many records share a stratum?
multi <- EC_rai |> count(flag, fleet, ymd, latCent, lonCent) |> filter(n > 1)
diagAdd("tables", "raised_shared_strata", data.frame(
	strata_with_several_records = nrow(multi),
	records_in_those_strata = sum(multi$n),
	pct_of_records = round(100 * sum(multi$n) / nrow(EC_rai), 2)))

saveIt(EC_rai, "LL_EC_rai.RDS")
saveIt(EC_list$dummy, "LL_rai_dummy.RDS")
```

# Geo referenced operational length frequency data (Tufman2)

```{r LF_opr_load}
LF_dat <- loadRaw("LF_tufman") |>
	runStep("LF_opr", paste0("sp_code == ", species, ", longline, LL observer + port"),
			function(d) dplyr::filter(d, sp_code == species, gear == "L",
									  data_source %in% c("longline observer", "port sampling"))) |>
	rename(flag = flag_id, gr = gear) |>
	mutate(ymd = as.Date(measure_date), len = as.numeric(len), id = as.character(id)) |>
	dplyr::select(-all_tuna_sampled, -all_tuna_unloaded)

# Snapshots for the input/processed diagnostic tables
LF_port_raw <- LF_dat |> filter(data_source == "port sampling")
LF_obs_raw  <- LF_dat |> filter(data_source == "longline observer")
```

## Data cleaning

```{r LF_opr_clean}
res <- runStep(LF_dat, "LF_opr", "convert coordinates (from)",
			   function(d) convert_coordinates_df(d, lat_col = "lat_from", lon_col = "lon_from", report = TRUE))
diagAdd("tables", "coords_LF_opr_from", res$summary)
LF_dat <- res$data

# observer rows have no lat_to/lon_to by construction
res <- runStep(LF_dat, "LF_opr", "convert coordinates (to)",
			   function(d) convert_coordinates_df(d, lat_col = "lat_to", lon_col = "lon_to", report = TRUE))
diagAdd("tables", "coords_LF_opr_to", res$summary)
LF_dat <- res$data

LF_dat <- runStep(LF_dat, "LF_opr", "remove_invalid", remove_invalid,
				  required_cols = c("len", "lat_from", "lon_from"))

LF_dat <- LF_dat |>
	mutate(latCent = ifelse(is.na(lat_to), roundTo.5(lat_from), roundTo.5((lat_from + lat_to) / 2)),
		   lonCent = ifelse(is.na(lon_to), roundTo.5(lon_from), roundTo.5((lon_from + lon_to) / 2)))

# infer first (recovers NULL/NM/XX from trip-mates), then convert SD/US/PS to
# UF with the config coefficients, then drop whatever is still not UF.
LF_dat <- runStep(LF_dat, "LF_opr", "infer_len_code_from_trip", infer_len_code_from_trip,
				  valid_codes = c("UF", names(len_conversion)))
LF_dat <- runStep(LF_dat, "LF_opr", "convert length codes to UF", convertLenCode,
				  conv = len_conversion)
LF_dat <- runStep(LF_dat, "LF_opr", "len_code == UF", filter_valid_categories,
				  col = "len_code", valid_values = "UF")
LF_dat <- runStep(LF_dat, "LF_opr", "trim_vesselname", trim_vesselname,
				  vesselname_col = "vesselname")
LF_dat$len <- customRound(LF_dat$len)

# Port: trip start/end can legitimately span land and sea, so bounding-box
# overlap only, no exact grid mask.
LF_port <- LF_dat |>
	filter(data_source == "port sampling") |>
	runStep("LF_port", "bounding box overlap",
			function(d) dplyr::filter(d, lat_to >= lat_range[1] & lat_from <= lat_range[2],
									  lon_to >= lon_range[1] & lon_from <= lon_range[2]))

# Observer: one exact point per set, range-check the point, then mask against
# the 1x1 land/sea grid.
LF_obs <- LF_dat |>
	filter(data_source == "longline observer") |>
	runStep("LF_obs", "filter_bounding_box", filter_bounding_box,
			lat_col = "lat_from", lon_col = "lon_from",
			lat_range = lat_range, lon_range = lon_range) |>
	runStep("LF_obs", "apply_pacific_mask", apply_pacific_mask,
			lat_col = "latCent", lon_col = "lonCent", pmask_lookup = pmask_lookup)

LF_dat <- bind_rows(LF_port, LF_obs)
saveIt(LF_dat, "LL_LF_opr.RDS")
```

```{r LF_opr_diag}
					   lat_col_raw = "lat_from", lon_col_raw = "lon_from",

knitr::kable(.diag$tables$stage_LF_port, caption = "Port sampling length frequency data: input vs processed")

```

```{r LF_opr_agg}
# multiple distinct ids on the same vessel-day are preserved as separate rows.
# LF_obs/LF_port can have >1 row per (flag, vesselname, ymd)
LF_agg <- LF_dat |>
	group_by(flag, vesselname, ymd, data_source, id) |>
	summarise(mean_len = mean(len, na.rm = TRUE),
			  lon_from = mean(lon_from, na.rm = TRUE),
			  lat_from = mean(lat_from, na.rm = TRUE),
			  lon_to = mean(lon_to, na.rm = TRUE),
			  lat_to = mean(lat_to, na.rm = TRUE),
			  count = n(),
			  .groups = "drop") |>
	mutate(latCent = ifelse(is.nan(lat_to), roundTo.5(lat_from), roundTo.5((lat_from + lat_to) / 2)),
		   lonCent = ifelse(is.nan(lon_to), roundTo.5(lon_from), roundTo.5((lon_from + lon_to) / 2)))

# Sanity: no id should have been dropped by this aggregation
if (n_distinct(LF_dat$id) != n_distinct(LF_agg$id))
	diagWarn("LF_opr | aggregation to samples", "ids lost when aggregating LF_dat to LF_agg")
diagAdd("tables", "LF_opr_agg", data.frame(fish = nrow(LF_dat), id_level_records = nrow(LF_agg),
										   ids = n_distinct(LF_agg$id)))
saveIt(LF_agg, "LL_LF_opr_agg.RDS")
```

# Adding length data to operational EC dataset

## Using operational LF

```{r add_length_from_opr}
# Split trip/day-level LF data by source
LF_obs <- LF_agg |>
	filter(data_source == "longline observer") |>
	rename(id_obs = id) |>
	dplyr::select(flag, vesselname, ymd, id_obs, mean_len, count)

LF_port <- LF_agg |>
	filter(data_source == "port sampling") |>
	rename(id_portsampling = id) |>
	dplyr::select(flag, vesselname, ymd, id_portsampling, mean_len, count)

# multiple ids per vessel-day is expected
if (anyDuplicated(LF_agg[, c("ymd", "flag", "vesselname", "data_source", "id")]) != 0)
	stop("Duplicated flag x vesselname x ymd x data_source x id in LF_agg not handled downstream")
# a single port-sampling id can't belong to two different trips/vessels
if (anyDuplicated(LF_port$id_portsampling) != 0)
	stop("Duplicated port sampling id in LF_agg not handled downstream")

# Link EC and LF: case 0, exact same-day observer match, plus trip grouping
EC_dat_IDed <- EC_opr |>
	dplyr::select(-type) |>
	mutate(origin_CE = TRUE) |>
	full_join(LF_obs |> rename(obs_mean_len = mean_len, obs_count = count) |> mutate(origin_LF_obs = TRUE),
			  by = c("flag", "vesselname", "ymd"), relationship = "many-to-many") |>
	full_join(LF_port |> mutate(origin_LF_port = TRUE),
			  by = c("flag", "vesselname", "ymd"), relationship = "many-to-many") |>
	mutate(origin = case_when(origin_CE & origin_LF_obs ~ "CE_LF_obs",
							  origin_CE                 ~ "CE",
							  origin_LF_obs             ~ "LF_obs",
							  origin_LF_port            ~ "LF_port",
							  TRUE ~ NA_character_)) |>
	dplyr::select(-matches("^origin_")) |>
	mutate(match_type = ifelse(origin == "CE_LF_obs", "flag-vesselname-date-observer", NA_character_)) |>
	arrange(flag, vesselname, ymd) |>
	group_by(flag, vesselname) |>
	mutate(date_diff = as.numeric(ymd - lag(ymd, default = first(ymd))),
		   new_group = cumsum(is.na(date_diff) | date_diff > trip_gap_days)) |>
	group_by(flag, vesselname, new_group) |>
	mutate(newtrip_id = cur_group_id()) |>
	ungroup() |>
	dplyr::select(-date_diff, -new_group)
```

```{r add_length_from_opr2}
# Case 0b: apportion each id_obs across every EC row it matches, weighted by the
# row's share of the TARGET species catch (numbers). Equal split when the id_obs
# group caught none of the target species.
EC_dat_IDed <- EC_dat_IDed |>
	group_by(id_obs) |>
	mutate(n_matches_obs = sum(match_type == "flag-vesselname-date-observer", na.rm = TRUE),
		   total_sp_obs  = sum(ifelse(match_type == "flag-vesselname-date-observer", .data[[sp_n]], NA), na.rm = TRUE),
		   weight_direct = case_when(
		   	match_type == "flag-vesselname-date-observer" & total_sp_obs > 0 ~ .data[[sp_n]] / total_sp_obs,
		   	match_type == "flag-vesselname-date-observer" ~ 1 / n_matches_obs,
		   	TRUE ~ NA_real_)) |>
	ungroup() |>
	dplyr::select(-n_matches_obs, -total_sp_obs)

# weight_direct must sum to 1 within every id_obs group, and be NA elsewhere
weight_direct_check <- EC_dat_IDed |>
	filter(match_type == "flag-vesselname-date-observer") |>
	group_by(id_obs) |>
	summarise(total_weight = sum(weight_direct, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
n_bad_weight_groups <- sum(abs(weight_direct_check$total_weight - 1) > 1e-6)
n_leaked <- sum(!is.na(EC_dat_IDed$weight_direct) &
					EC_dat_IDed$match_type != "flag-vesselname-date-observer", na.rm = TRUE)
if (n_bad_weight_groups > 0) diagWarn("length matching", "weight_direct groups not summing to 1: ", n_bad_weight_groups)
if (n_leaked > 0) diagWarn("length matching", "non-NA weight_direct outside direct-match rows: ", n_leaked)
diagAdd("tables", "weight_direct_check",
		data.frame(id_obs_groups = nrow(weight_direct_check),
				   groups_not_summing_to_1 = n_bad_weight_groups, leaked = n_leaked))
```

```{r add_length_from_opr3}
# Case 1: forward-fill the next upcoming port-sampling id within each trip.
# Weight = row's share of the target catch among the EC rows of the trip/id;
# equal split among EC rows when that catch is 0 (the YFT version gave NaN,
# and the port sample was lost).
EC_dat_IDed <- EC_dat_IDed |>
	group_by(newtrip_id) |>
	tidyr::fill(id_portsampling, .direction = "up") |>
	ungroup() |>
	group_by(newtrip_id, id_portsampling) |>
	mutate(sum_sp = sum(.data[[sp_n]], na.rm = TRUE),
		   n_ec   = sum(!is.na(.data[[sp_n]])),
		   weight_portsampling = case_when(is.na(.data[[sp_n]]) ~ NA_real_,
		   								sum_sp > 0 ~ .data[[sp_n]] / sum_sp,
		   								TRUE ~ 1 / n_ec)) |>
	ungroup() |>
	dplyr::select(-sum_sp, -n_ec) |>
	mutate(match_type = ifelse(is.na(match_type) & !is.na(id_portsampling),
							   "same_continuous_trip-next_portsampling_measure", match_type))
```

```{r add_length_from_opr4}
# Case 2: proxy length from other observer measures in the same trip
trip_proxy <- EC_dat_IDed |>
	filter(!is.na(id_obs)) |>
	distinct(newtrip_id, ymd, id_obs, obs_mean_len, obs_count) |>
	group_by(newtrip_id) |>
	summarise(proxy_mean_len = sum(obs_mean_len * obs_count, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(obs_count, na.rm = TRUE),
			  n_id_obs = n_distinct(id_obs),
			  .groups = "drop")

EC_dat_IDed <- EC_dat_IDed |>
	left_join(trip_proxy, by = "newtrip_id") |>
	mutate(match_type = ifelse(is.na(match_type) & !is.na(proxy_mean_len) & is.na(id_portsampling),
							   "same_continuous_trip-other_observer_measures", match_type))

saveIt(EC_dat_IDed |> dplyr::select(match_type, id_obs, id_portsampling, weight_direct, origin),
	   "EC_dat_IDed_subsetcols.RDS")
```

```{r add_length_from_opr5}
# Record-level result: real measurement (observer or port) kept separate from proxy
CE_dat_mean_len <- EC_dat_IDed |>
	left_join(LF_port |> rename(port_mean_len = mean_len, port_count = count) |>
			  	dplyr::select(id_portsampling, port_mean_len, port_count),
			  by = "id_portsampling") |>
	mutate(mean_len = case_when(match_type == "flag-vesselname-date-observer" ~ obs_mean_len,
								match_type == "same_continuous_trip-next_portsampling_measure" ~ port_mean_len,
								TRUE ~ NA_real_),
		   count = case_when(match_type == "flag-vesselname-date-observer" ~ obs_count,
		   				  match_type == "same_continuous_trip-next_portsampling_measure" ~ port_count * weight_portsampling,
		   				  TRUE ~ NA_real_),
		   id = case_when(match_type == "flag-vesselname-date-observer" ~ id_obs,
		   			   match_type == "same_continuous_trip-next_portsampling_measure" ~ id_portsampling,
		   			   TRUE ~ NA_character_)) |>
	dplyr::select(-obs_mean_len, -obs_count, -port_mean_len, -port_count, -n_id_obs) |>
	filter(!origin %in% c("LF_obs", "LF_port"))

diagAdd("tables", "match_types", as.data.frame(table(match_type = CE_dat_mean_len$match_type, useNA = "ifany")))
saveIt(CE_dat_mean_len, "CE_dat_mean_len.RDS")
```

```{r add_length_from_opr6}
# Monthly aggregation (vessel x month x 1 deg cell).
# Real length data always takes strict precedence over proxy.
EC_LF_month <- CE_dat_mean_len |>
	mutate(ymd_month = make_date(year(ymd), month(ymd), 15)) |>
	group_by(flag, vesselname, ymd_month, latCent, lonCent) |>
	summarise(
		avg_mean_len = sum(mean_len * count, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(count, na.rm = TRUE),
		avg_proxy_mean_len = mean(proxy_mean_len, na.rm = TRUE),
		across(all_of(c(n_cols, w_cols, "E")), sum),
		mean_hbf = mean(hbf[hbf_outlier == "valid"], na.rm = TRUE),
		n_hbf_valid           = sum(hbf_outlier == "valid", na.rm = TRUE),
		n_hbf_missing         = sum(hbf_outlier == "missing", na.rm = TRUE),
		n_hbf_non_positive    = sum(hbf_outlier == "non_positive", na.rm = TRUE),
		n_hbf_above_threshold = sum(hbf_outlier == "above_threshold", na.rm = TRUE),
		.groups = "drop") |>
	mutate(mean_len = ifelse(!is.na(avg_mean_len), avg_mean_len, avg_proxy_mean_len),
		   len_source = case_when(!is.na(avg_mean_len) ~ "operational_real",
		   						  !is.na(avg_proxy_mean_len) ~ "operational_proxy",
		   						  TRUE ~ NA_character_),
		   # "valid" if at least one record fed mean_hbf; if more than one bad
		   # category is present, the original category is ambiguous -> "mixed_invalid"
		   hbf_outlier = case_when(
		   	n_hbf_valid > 0 ~ "valid",
		   	(n_hbf_missing > 0) + (n_hbf_non_positive > 0) + (n_hbf_above_threshold > 0) > 1 ~ "mixed_invalid",
		   	n_hbf_missing > 0 ~ "missing",
		   	n_hbf_non_positive > 0 ~ "non_positive",
		   	n_hbf_above_threshold > 0 ~ "above_threshold",
		   	TRUE ~ NA_character_))

EC_LF_month$total_n <- rowSums(EC_LF_month[, n_cols])
n_month_before <- nrow(EC_LF_month)
EC_LF_month <- EC_LF_month |> filter(total_n > 0)
for (s in species_all) EC_LF_month[[paste0(s, "_fraction")]] <- EC_LF_month[[paste0(s, "_n")]] / EC_LF_month$total_n

EC_LF_month <- EC_LF_month |>
	rename(latitude = latCent, longitude = lonCent, ymd = ymd_month) |>
	dplyr::select(-avg_proxy_mean_len) |>
	mutate(row_id = row_number())

n_ec_total <- nrow(EC_LF_month)
n_ec_tier1 <- sum(!is.na(EC_LF_month$mean_len))
diagAdd("tables", "monthly_aggregation",
		data.frame(records = n_month_before, removed_total_n_0 = n_month_before - n_ec_total))
```

```{r add_length_from_opr7}
# Extrapolate missing weights (NA = some fish without weight, see tidyCatch()):
# n x mean weight per fish of the same month and 5 deg cell, all years pooled.
# Done for every species, as the delta (raised - operational) uses all weights.
EC_LF_month <- EC_LF_month |>
	mutate(lat5 = roundTo2.5(latitude), lon5 = roundTo2.5(longitude), mm = month(ymd))
key_rec <- paste(EC_LF_month$mm, EC_LF_month$lat5, EC_LF_month$lon5)

w_extrap <- list()
for (s in species_all) {
	n <- paste0(s, "_n"); w <- paste0(s, "_w")
	EC_LF_month[[w]][EC_LF_month[[n]] == 0 & is.na(EC_LF_month[[w]])] <- 0
	# records with a weight but no number (n set to 0 by tidyCatch()) would
	# inflate the mean weight per fish: left out of the reference
	ref <- EC_LF_month |>
		filter(!is.na(.data[[w]]), .data[[n]] > 0) |>
		group_by(mm, lat5, lon5) |>
		summarise(mean_w = ifelse(sum(.data[[n]]) > 0, sum(.data[[w]]) / sum(.data[[n]]), NA_real_),
				  .groups = "drop")
	miss <- is.na(EC_LF_month[[w]])
	idx  <- match(key_rec[miss], paste(ref$mm, ref$lat5, ref$lon5))
	EC_LF_month[[w]][miss] <- EC_LF_month[[n]][miss] * ref$mean_w[idx]
	w_extrap[[s]] <- data.frame(species = s, extrapolated = sum(miss),
								still_na = sum(is.na(EC_LF_month[[w]])))
}
diagAdd("tables", "weight_extrapolation", do.call(rbind, w_extrap))
knitr::kable(.diag$tables$weight_extrapolation, row.names = FALSE,
			 caption = "Monthly records with missing catch weight, extrapolated from mean weight per fish")

EC_LF_month <- EC_LF_month |> dplyr::select(-lat5, -lon5, -mm)
saveIt(EC_LF_month, "LL_EC_LF_opr_mm.RDS")
```

```{r add_length_from_opr8}
# Rebuild LF-id correspondence at group level (cheaper than list-columns per record)
real_ids <- CE_dat_mean_len |>
	filter(!is.na(id)) |>
	distinct(flag, vesselname, ymd, latCent, lonCent, id) |>
	mutate(ymd_month = make_date(year(ymd), month(ymd), 15))

proxy_ids <- EC_dat_IDed |>
	filter(!is.na(id_obs)) |>
	distinct(newtrip_id, id_obs) |>
	inner_join(CE_dat_mean_len |> distinct(flag, vesselname, newtrip_id, ymd, latCent, lonCent) |>
			   	mutate(ymd_month = make_date(year(ymd), month(ymd), 15)),
			   by = "newtrip_id", relationship = "many-to-many") |>
	dplyr::select(flag, vesselname, ymd_month, latCent, lonCent, id_obs)

corresp_EC_LF_ids <- EC_LF_month |>
	dplyr::select(row_id, flag, vesselname, ymd, latitude, longitude) |>
	left_join(real_ids, by = c("flag", "vesselname", "ymd" = "ymd_month",
							   "latitude" = "latCent", "longitude" = "lonCent")) |>
	left_join(proxy_ids, by = c("flag", "vesselname", "ymd" = "ymd_month",
								"latitude" = "latCent", "longitude" = "lonCent"),
			  relationship = "many-to-many") |>
	group_by(row_id) |>
	summarise(ids = list(unique(na.omit(id))),
			  proxy_ids = list(unique(na.omit(id_obs))),
			  .groups = "drop")

saveIt(corresp_EC_LF_ids, "LL_EC_LF_opr_mm_correspIds.RDS")
```

## Using aggregated LF

```{r add_length_from_agg}
# 1. Box edges + sea-cell count per unique aggregated-LF rectangle
LFr_regions <- LF_uniform_bins |>
	distinct(ASTRAT, latCent, lonCent) |>
	rename(lat_region = latCent, lon_region = lonCent) |>
	left_join(astrat_lookup, by = "ASTRAT") |>
	mutate(lat_from = lat_region - lat_offset, lat_to = lat_region + lat_offset,
		   lon_from = lon_region - lon_offset, lon_to = lon_region + lon_offset,
		   nb_cells = (lat_offset * 2) * (lon_offset * 2),
		   id_region = row_number())

sea_counts <- LFr_regions |>
	left_join(pmask_lookup,
			  by = join_by(lat_from <= latCent, lat_to >= latCent,
			  			 lon_from <= lonCent, lon_to >= lonCent),
			  relationship = "many-to-many") |>
	group_by(id_region) |>
	summarise(n_sea = sum(!is.na(latCent)), .groups = "drop")

# 2. prop_sea + zero-sea guard
LFr_regions <- LFr_regions |>
	left_join(sea_counts, by = "id_region") |>
	mutate(prop_sea = n_sea / nb_cells) |>
	dplyr::select(-n_sea)

n_zero_sea <- sum(LFr_regions$prop_sea == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
diagAdd("tables", "LF_regions", data.frame(regions = nrow(LFr_regions), all_land = n_zero_sea))
# all-land rectangles excluded from weighting to avoid division by zero
LFr_regions <- LFr_regions |> filter(prop_sea > 0)
saveIt(LFr_regions, "LFr_regions.RDS")

# 3. Weighted mean length per rectangle (year-specific)
LFr_mean_len <- LF_uniform_bins |>
	group_by(ASTRAT, latCent, lonCent, yr, qtr, flag) |>
	summarise(mean_len = sum(len * count) / sum(count),
			  count = sum(count),
			  .groups = "drop") |>
	left_join(LFr_regions, by = c("ASTRAT", "latCent" = "lat_region", "lonCent" = "lon_region")) |>
	mutate(weight = count / (nb_cells * prop_sea),
		   lf_row_id = row_number())
```

```{r add_length_from_agg2}
# Dedupe to unique (flag, cell, quarter) combos before the spatial lookup
CE_notmatched <- EC_LF_month |>
	filter(is.na(mean_len)) |>
	dplyr::select(-mean_len) |>
	mutate(yr = year(ymd), qtr = quarter(ymd))

lookup_keys <- CE_notmatched |> distinct(flag, latitude, longitude, yr, qtr)

joined_year <- lookup_keys |>
	left_join(LFr_mean_len, by = c("flag", "yr", "qtr"), relationship = "many-to-many") |>
	filter(lon_from <= longitude, lon_to >= longitude,
		   lat_from <= latitude, lat_to >= latitude)

matched <- joined_year |>
	group_by(flag, latitude, longitude, yr, qtr) |>
	summarise(n_measures_from_raised = n(),
			  mean_len = sum(mean_len * weight) / sum(weight),
			  .groups = "drop")

n_lf_total_yr <- nrow(LFr_mean_len)
n_lf_used_yr  <- n_distinct(joined_year$lf_row_id)

CE_notmatched <- CE_notmatched |>
	left_join(matched, by = c("flag", "latitude", "longitude", "yr", "qtr")) |>
	mutate(len_source = ifelse(!is.na(mean_len), "aggregated_year", NA_character_))
n_ec_tier2 <- sum(!is.na(CE_notmatched$mean_len))

EC_LF_mm <- EC_LF_month |>
	filter(!is.na(mean_len)) |>
	bind_rows(CE_notmatched |> dplyr::select(all_of(names(EC_LF_month)))) |>
	arrange(row_id)
```

## Using aggregated LF averaged across years (fallback)

```{r add_length_from_agg_acrossyears}
# Same weighting as LFr_mean_len, grouped without `yr`: length data from any
# year in the same flag/region/quarter fills records whose year has no LF.
LFr_mean_len_allyr <- LF_uniform_bins |>
	group_by(ASTRAT, latCent, lonCent, qtr, flag) |>
	summarise(mean_len = sum(len * count) / sum(count),
			  count = sum(count),
			  .groups = "drop") |>
	left_join(LFr_regions, by = c("ASTRAT", "latCent" = "lat_region", "lonCent" = "lon_region")) |>
	mutate(weight = count / (nb_cells * prop_sea),
		   lf_row_id = row_number())

CE_notmatched_allyr <- EC_LF_mm |>
	filter(is.na(mean_len)) |>
	dplyr::select(-mean_len) |>
	mutate(qtr = quarter(ymd))

lookup_keys_allyr <- CE_notmatched_allyr |> distinct(flag, latitude, longitude, qtr)

joined_allyr <- lookup_keys_allyr |>
	left_join(LFr_mean_len_allyr, by = c("flag", "qtr"), relationship = "many-to-many") |>
	filter(lon_from <= longitude, lon_to >= longitude,
		   lat_from <= latitude, lat_to >= latitude)

matched_allyr <- joined_allyr |>
	group_by(flag, latitude, longitude, qtr) |>
	summarise(n_measures_from_raised = n(),
			  mean_len = sum(mean_len * weight) / sum(weight),
			  .groups = "drop")

n_lf_total_allyr <- nrow(LFr_mean_len_allyr)
n_lf_used_allyr  <- n_distinct(joined_allyr$lf_row_id)

CE_notmatched_allyr <- CE_notmatched_allyr |>
	left_join(matched_allyr, by = c("flag", "latitude", "longitude", "qtr")) |>
	mutate(len_source = ifelse(!is.na(mean_len), "aggregated_allyear", len_source)) |>
	dplyr::select(all_of(names(EC_LF_mm)))
n_ec_tier3 <- sum(!is.na(CE_notmatched_allyr$mean_len))

EC_LF_mm <- EC_LF_mm |>
	filter(!is.na(mean_len)) |>
	bind_rows(CE_notmatched_allyr) |>
	arrange(row_id)

saveIt(EC_LF_mm, "LL_EC_LF_mm.RDS")
```

## Coverage summary

```{r coverage_summary}
diagAdd("tables", "lf_coverage", tibble::tibble(
	Tier = c("Tier 1 (operational LF, direct/proxy match)",
			 "Tier 2 (aggregated LF, year-specific)",
			 "Tier 3 (aggregated LF, all years)",
			 "No length"),
	N_matched = c(n_ec_tier1, n_ec_tier2, n_ec_tier3,
				  n_ec_total - n_ec_tier1 - n_ec_tier2 - n_ec_tier3),
	N_total = n_ec_total) |>
	mutate(Pct = round(100 * N_matched / N_total, 1),
		   Pct_cumulative = c(cumsum(Pct[1:3]), NA)))
knitr::kable(.diag$tables$lf_coverage, caption = paste("Monthly operational records with a", species, "mean length, by matching tier"))

diagAdd("tables", "lf_usage", data.frame(
	source = c("aggregated LF, year-specific", "aggregated LF, all years"),
	lf_entries = c(n_lf_total_yr, n_lf_total_allyr),
	used = c(n_lf_used_yr, n_lf_used_allyr)) |>
	mutate(pct_used = round(100 * used / lf_entries, 1)))
knitr::kable(.diag$tables$lf_usage, caption = "Aggregated LF entries matched to at least one EC record")
```
